subject: Proposal: bridge-year swap + upgrade window (two-step ramp)
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Mueller <lena.mueller@cobalthealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: bridge-year swap + upgrade window (two-step ramp)

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for a productive Renewal call last week. Per our conversation I put together a short, two-step structure that should get Cobalt Health to the committed capacity you need for FY28 while aligning invoice cadence into your fiscal July year. High level:

- Bridge year (FY27->FY28): 9-month transitional term to sync to your July co-term date.
- Upgrade window at month 7 of the bridge year: optional +30% burst at preferred pricing for accelerated rollout.
- Year 1 (co-termed FY28): standard committed units with a 6-month ramp-to-commit schedule.

I've attached the editable bridge plan (2027Q2-Renewal-Bridge-Plan.xlsx) and a one-page term summary. Key asks from our side:
1) Sign-off on co-term target date (01-Jul-2027).
2) Confirmation if you want the upgrade window to be executed as an automatic scheduled uplift (auto-apply) or as a manual PO-triggered uplift.

If you prefer, I can loop in Marissa (billing) and Vivek (account exec) to get pricing and any legal redlines included.

Next steps: if you confirm the co-term target I’ll share a formal amendment and a PO template for your procurement.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Attachments: 2027Q2-Renewal-Bridge-Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), Bridge-Year-Term-Summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Lena Mueller <lena.mueller@cobalthealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@cobalthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Proposal: bridge-year swap + upgrade window (two-step ramp)

Sergio —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick clarifying questions from procurement and finance:

- On billing: Will the bridge period be invoiced pro-rata on a monthly basis or as a single consolidated invoice at the start of the bridge? We prefer consolidated if possible.
- Upgrade window: If we take the +30% uplift, does that increase our committed baseline for following years or is it treated purely as burst usage that settles as overage?
- Auto-renew: Our procurement team needs the ability to opt-out at the 12-month mark without penalty for budget reasons — is that something you can support in the amendment?

We also want the billing dates to align with our July fiscal cadence — target co-term of 01-Jul-2027 works for us but we need the invoice date to be 01-Jul.

Thanks,
Lena Mueller
Head of Data & Analytics | Cobalt Health
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Mueller <lena.mueller@cobalthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: bridge-year swap + upgrade window (two-step ramp)

Lena —

Great questions. Short answers:

- Billing cadence: We can do a consolidated invoice for the bridge period issued on 01-Jul-2027 (we'll pro-rate calculation in the background).
- Upgrade window treatment: The +30% uplift during the 7th month will be billed as an addendum (burst) and will not auto-permanently increase your baseline committed units unless you elect to convert the uplift into a new baseline during the post-bridge amendment. We can include a conversion option in the amendment that would lock the uplift into year-1 baseline rates (with a 30-day convert window).
- Auto-renew opt-out: We can include an opt-out clause at month 12 for enterprise customers with a 60-day notice period; Marissa, can you confirm standard language?

I’m attaching a quick example of the two-step schedule in the attached spreadsheet (see "Schedule" tab). If this aligns I’ll request Marissa to create the official amendment with those clauses and pricing lines.

Best,
Sergio
Attachments: 2027Q2-Renewal-Bridge-Plan.xlsx (see Schedule tab)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Mueller <lena.mueller@cobalthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: bridge-year swap + upgrade window (two-step ramp) — pricing & T&Cs

Hi all —

Attached is the pricing appendix and a draft amendment (Bridge-Year-Term-Summary.pdf + Pricing-Appendix.csv). Notes:

- Consolidated invoice date: 01-Jul-2027 (single invoice for bridge pro-rata).
- Bridge term pricing: blended rate applied for the 9-month term; see row 4 of the CSV for per-token equivalent and committed unit rates.
- Upgrade window: charged as billed burst. Conversion option: 30-day window post-upgrade to move burst into baseline at a discounted conversion fee (0.85x list).
- Auto-renew: proposed clause allows opt-out at month 12 with 60 days' notice. For customers requiring stricter termination rights we can add a 6-month out clause but that will change pricing.

Action items for Lena:
1) Confirm consolidated invoice acceptance and PO timeline.
2) Confirm manual vs auto-apply for the upgrade window (we recommend manual PO-triggered to avoid accidental spend).

If Lena confirms, legal will prep a redline-friendly amendment and I’ll push to DocuSign with the HubSpot deal linked.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Renewals & RevOps | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Pricing-Appendix.csv (csv), Bridge-Year-Term-Summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Lena Mueller <lena.mueller@cobalthealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@cobalthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:40:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Proposal: bridge-year swap + upgrade window (two-step ramp)

Marissa / Sergio —

Thanks for the detailed appendix — that addresses the majority of procurement's questions. Confirming:

- We accept a consolidated invoice on 01-Jul-2027 for the 9-month bridge term.
- Upgrade window: we will elect manual PO-triggered uplift (we'll only exercise after our internal pilot in month 6 passes).
- Conversion option: we'll keep the 30-day conversion window but will let you know if we want to convert before the bridge ends.
- Auto-renew opt-out: 60-day notice at month 12 is acceptable.

Next steps: please send the amendment + PO template and the DocuSign when ready. Evan will be our procurement lead on the PO side (copied).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lena
